performance.verdict: ROAS surge is real but GBP collapse and 4 overdue SOW gates demand immediate resolution.

findings.text: ROAS hit 5.48 on $1,487.76 spend (28d), up 74.94% week-over-week; 3-day purchases (Sep 19–21: 2+2+1=5) match prior 3 days (Sep 16–18: 2+0+2=4) — efficiency gain is holding, not fading.
4 SOW milestones overdue: Aug 14 live-cooking video, Aug 31 pre-launch gate, Aug 31 platform audit, and Aug 31 funnel test + UTM live — all unresolved as of Sep 22.
GBP actions collapsed from ~25–47/day in early Sep to 0 for Sep 19–21 (3 consecutive zero days); daily verdict flagged -91.03% weekly — this is a confirmed signal, not noise.
Revenue is highly volatile day-to-day (range $0–$1,727 over 45 days) with 8 zero-revenue days; purchase volume is thin at avg ~1.6/day, making ROAS reading sensitive to single large orders.
IG reach declining: 3-day avg Sep 19–21 is 611 vs prior 3-day avg Sep 16–18 of 672; down from ~900+ in early Sep — organic amplification is softening alongside paid momentum.

suggestions.text: Raise BWS - Sales - Muslims daily budget +20% (~+$11/day from ~$54/day baseline); ROAS 5.48 confirmed above floor.
suggestions.monday_update: ROAS is confirmed at 5.48 (28d, $1,487.76 spend) with 74.94% week-over-week improvement and purchases holding in the 3-day window (5 purchases Sep 19–21). Raise the BWS - Sales - Muslims daily budget by approximately 20% (~+$11/day off the $54.09/day average). Note: revenue is volatile and single large orders skew ROAS, so monitor purchase count — not just revenue — daily. Confirm efficiency is holding (ROAS ≥ 4.0) by Sep 25 before any further step.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP profile immediately: 3 consecutive zero-action days Sep 19–21 after averaging 25–47 actions/day in early September.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero for three consecutive days (Sep 19, 20, 21) after averaging 25–47 daily actions in early September — a confirmed signal, not a data blip. Check for a suspended or suppressed profile listing, missing business hours, or a reporting API disconnect before attributing this to organic softness. Success is restoration of GBP actions to ≥15/day. Re-check by Sep 25.

suggestions.text: Watch 4 overdue SOW milestones (Aug 14 video, Aug 31 gate/audit/funnel+UTM): escalate to Nacer; no paid action until UTM is live.
suggestions.monday_update: Four SOW milestones remain unresolved past their Aug 14 and Aug 31 deadlines: the live-cooking event video, pre-launch gate, platform ownership audit, and the funnel test closure with UTM tracking live. Without UTM live, Windsor/Meta attribution cannot be cross-referenced against Shopify as specified in the engagement plan, undermining any scaling decision. Escalate all four to Nacer (Ops) immediately. No further budget scaling decisions should be made until the funnel test + UTM milestone is cleared — re-check status by Sep 25.
